qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.boundedRule: Tier one admits only the exact three-byte, one-instruction CR3 writes at the two measured fixture RIPs with their measured RAX/RDI sources. The same operation at another RIP declines.
admission.validation: Every execution validates reserved physical-address bits before native entry and declines PCID bit-63 no-flush requests to the interpreter. User-mode and non-long-mode cases also decline before effects.
admission.coherency: Each admitted write is an isolated dispatch boundary. Successful publication updates architectural CR3, invalidates the translated-memory paging unit, flushes the executor JIT TLB, and returns before another guest instruction can run under the new root.
admission.deferred: PCID no-flush writes and every unmeasured control-register write remain interpreter-owned.

verification.focusedGate: The measured CR3-write and 54-word ABI-layout tests pass.
verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,449 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Both measured encodings match the interpreter while preserving GPRs and flags; a two-instruction chain retires only the CR3 write at the mandatory dispatch boundary.
verification.faultCoverage: Reserved-high-bit and no-flush values leave state unchanged for precise interpreter retry; user mode and an adjacent RIP decline atomically.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. The elapsed and decline differences are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.

interpretation: Both measured CR3-write sites are absent from the retained negative-cache sample and the authenticated workload completes. A05.2 remains open because 126,310 of 224,212 full-run tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
